verdict.rationale: Pulumi's docs name stacks and config as core concepts, the pricing page advertises unlimited projects, stacks and environments, and a community user reports managing 5+ separate environments with Pulumi. However, no evidence explicitly documents using one stack per environment with stack-specific config values. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-stack configuration (e.g., per-stack config files or setting config per stack), a documented dev/staging/prod stack workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of per-environment config separation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage per-environment configuration (dev, staging, prod) as separate stacks or workspaces

citations.quote: Dig into the details of how Pulumi works: projects, stacks, config, secrets, and more.
